intro: Treasure hunters, look closely. We are hunting for nature clues!
praise: What a clever find! Tell me why it counts.
cheer: You found a whole collection of nature clues!
classic-cheer: Five fantastic finds! You noticed texture, color, shape, size, and sound.
classic-s1: Find something smooth. Hold it up and say why it counts.
classic-s1-after: Time to show your smooth treasure and say why it counts.
classic-s2: Find something green. Hold it up and say why it counts.
classic-s3: Find something round. Hold it up and say why it counts.
classic-s4: Find something tiny. Hold it up and say why it counts.
classic-s5: Find something that makes a sound when you shake it. Hold it up and say why it counts.
texture-praise: Ooh, what does your treasure feel like?
texture-cheer: Feely hunt complete! Your fingertips discovered four textures.
texture-s1: Find something bumpy. Feel all the little bumps.
texture-s2: Find something soft. Touch it gently.
texture-s3: Find something cold. Touch it for just a moment.
texture-s4: Find something tickly. Now close your eyes and feel-test all your treasures.
